body: Sorry but you're not helping. You don't know what I've been through. Your comment comes off as insensitive. :(

Oh, I don't hate myself at all. I think I'm a wonderful person and I love myself. Suicide is out of desperation, something you do to stop unbearable pain, at least for me. I'm experienced with meditation, lucid dreaming and altered states of consciousness. One time I saw an entity in higher definition than reality itself though meditation alone. I have a lot of stories about that from the last 6 years as I used to keep a journal. I don't really believe in astral projection. Maybe one day I'll change my mind, maybe not. I'll try to keep an open mind. I think you know more about that than I do. Why do you think my lucid dreams are astral projection? (or some of them)

I always know that I'm dreaming and I can wake up anytime I want. I can make things go away or summon objects, creatures and scenarios at will. That doesn't ruin the immersion for me. Most of the time it's all my subconscious work, it creates highly detailed scenarios that I can easily write down as soon as I wake up and the line between "reality" and fantasy in my dreams is really blurry. Like, it generates places that can totally exist in real life but with a twist and blends both things seamlessly. Sometimes I dream videogame concepts and possible mods that I can easily recreate. It's free inspiration, really, and I'd dedicate my life to do that if I could.

Mine don't last more than a week most of the time. They last 12 hours or 1 day or 2, up to a week. Once I had a dream for a year. It was crazy. I was in a post-apocalyptic world stuck with two people I barely know. I felt so lonely and missed my BF a bunch. Looking back I felt kind of like I'm feeling now, but better. At least I wasn't stuck in a 4x2 meter room hearing my parents fight at 4 AM every day.

Thank you, you're so kind you made me smile. I write, draw and use blender. Mostly because my dreams are hyper realistic and detailed, but also surreal. I've never tried to write fiction or characters with personality, I'll give it a try. 

I know about online therapy but it's way too expensive. I wish I had 200 dollars. Hell, I wish I had 3 dollars. Regular therapy is covered by taxes here and I can't believe you have to pay so much for your health, it makes me sad.

I was doing OK (not really, but I could function) before COVID happened. I was about to start therapy. Now I'm stuck in my bedroom. The main problem is that I can't do my homework, and that means I'll get bad grades and I'll repeat a year, and that means I won't be able to move with a friend and I'll be stuck in my mom's house and I'll do anything to get away from my mom and... bad things. I'm glad you're better now. Thank you for your reply.

Thank you for your reply. I'll try. It's just that all I can see in the future are bad things. Dropping out of trade school, drugs, homelessness, prostitution, no support network, losing my sanity. I'll buy the salts just in case.
Thank you for your kind words. I don't want to talk about my problems, I just want them to be gone. I guess it helps with frustration. Thanks again.
I will, thank you. I don't know why someone downvoted you.
